stories.title: Firearm bear season underway in Pennsylvania
stories.summary: Statewide firearms bear season runs Saturday through Tuesday, November 24th.

stories.title: Santa arrives in downtown Wilkes-Barre at the annual Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting Ceremony
stories.summary: The Christmas parade kicked off at 3 p.m. and was followed by the annual Christmas Tree Lighting.

stories.title: Community comes together to support 7-year-old girl battling cancer
stories.summary: All money raised at 'Sweets for Selah' will go towards supporting Selah, her five siblings, and her parents.

stories.title: Family of late U.S. Army veteran receives new burial flag
stories.summary: The original flag was lost in the 1972 Wyoming Valley flood.

stories.title: Landscaping company brings holiday cheer with inaugural Christmas market in Wilkes-Barre.
stories.summary: Holmgren Landscaping held its first holiday market, using it for holiday cheer and as a fundraiser for Toys for Tots for the Hanover Area Lions Club.

stories.title: Vintage market at Montage Mountain kickstarts holiday shopping season in Lackawanna County
stories.summary: The inaugural Montage Vintage and Thrift event in Lackawanna County showcased over 25 vendors.

stories.title: Lights set up for annual WEJL Tower Lighting Celebration
stories.summary: The tower lighting takes place downtown Scranton on November 25th.

stories.title: Scranton begins converting downtown streets to two-way traffic
stories.summary: Phase two of Scranton's Streetscapes Project brings significant changes for travelers coming through Downtown Scranton.

stories.title: Congressman Tim Holden is remembered in Schuylkill County
stories.summary: A line formed outside the door and spilled onto the sidewalk, filled with people eager to honor Holden, who had served in Congress for 20 years.

stories.title: Brian Baumgartner visits University of Scranton to discuss new 'Office'-inspired book
stories.summary: Actor Brian Baumgartner, who played 'Kevin' on the hit show 'The Office,' stopped by the University of Scranton to discuss his new book.

stories.title: Samaritan's Purse continues Operation Christmas Child ministry in central Pennsylvania
stories.summary: It is the season of giving, and a charity near Sunbury is collecting shoeboxes full of gifts for children in need.

stories.title: Christmas tree buyers flock to Buffalo Valley Produce Auction to choose from thousands of evergreens
stories.summary: Newswatch 16's Mackenzie Aucker stopped by the Buffalo Valley Produce Auction to check out how this year's evergreens are shaping up.
